cj-yeongdeungpo-2022.facts: Starium replaced by ScreenX PLF; reopened 2022-06-11 with 462 seats. Nine private boxes: seven two-person, two four-person, on floors 7/8.

cj-yeongdeungpo-2026.facts: Uses current venue name CGV영등포타임스퀘어 SCREENX for 2026-08-23 event.

lotte-dimensions.facts: WorldTower Superplex G screen 34 m wide and 13.8 m high.

lotte-booking.facts: Indexed official booking states 21관 수퍼플렉스 LASER total 295 seats. Live reader returned shell; counts from indexed result.

cgv-partner-catalog.publisher: Korea Chamber partner benefits catalog, CGV brand page
cgv-partner-catalog.facts: Yongsan IMAX 31 by 22.4 m; historical brand material, not a fresh survey.

wangsimni-secondary.facts: Reports 22 by 13.3m, 268 seats, 10 rows. Claims matching current official seatmap, not independently reverified here.

yongsan-secondary.facts: Reports 31 by 22.4m, 624 seats, 16 rows. Metric row pitch, rake, front distance are expressly modeled on this source.

catalog-secondary.facts: Reports Gwanggyo IMAX 20 by 12m, 282 seats; Cheonho 24.7 by 18.7m, 323 seats; Ilsan 21 by 11.5m, 250 seats.

pangyo-closure.facts: Reports CGV Pangyo closing after 2026-08-19, citing CGV; includes photograph of closure notice. Primary operator notice not retrieved.

coex-official.facts: Official venue page confirms Coex name. Reader gets JS shell without room layout.

namyangju-official.facts: Official venue page confirms 남양주현대아울렛스페이스원 name. Reader gets JS shell without room layout.

coex-capacity.facts: Coex Dolby Cinema launched with 378 seats.

coex-dimensions.facts: Historical Coex M auditorium 17.4 by 7.4m. This predates Dolby renovation and cannot itself prove current size.

namyangju-dimensions.facts: Reports 20.5 by 11.7m. No primary dimension source located.

wheelchair-guide.facts: Links operator seatmap screenshots. Yongsan wheelchair positions A17,18,19,22,23,24; Wangsimni A9,10,11; Gwanggyo A12,13,14,15. Do not reproduce guide template/images.

wangsimni-renewal.facts: Wangsimni IMAX reopens 2024-09-11 with IMAX Laser and immersive sound. Does not give new seat count or dimensions.

worldtower-renewal.facts: Renovated auditorium uses 34m wide curved/tilted screen and 295 seats. Physical screen height/curvature radius/tilt not established.
